### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page; `/widgets` without the final slash works.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly, without first removing a final slash, so `/widgets/` never matches the widgets page. Removing the slash before comparing made the page load in the local test.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash from an address before comparing it, so both forms reach the same page. The existing ticket already covers this and will track the fix: https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42. No new ticket was created.
